geometry_notes: Origin at mid-soffit, y up; single void as an interior ring.
Void internal consistency: 280 normal web with the 250:1450 slope gives 915.9/729.7 half-widths at the haunch ends vs printed 916/730.
R50 corners are exact tangent arcs (32 segments). Gross outline without fillets and groove: 2 568 520 mm2 (a=0); fillets net -170 mm2.
Drip groove: R20 circle centred on the wing soffit 150 mm from the tip (a semicircular cut, 1257 mm2 for both); on the tapered soffit when a<170. Option drip_groove=False omits it.
Excluded: ø100 vent holes (web, 1000 above soffit), ø600 access hole, ø100/ø160 drain holes, end thickening of sections II–II/III–III, 20x20 end chamfers.
No published section properties; the values below are analytic only.
Registry correction: an earlier note read an outer depth of 1600 at II–II; the drawing gives 1800 (200+150+1450) at every section.
